landing.lead: Streamline your freelance finances with intelligent time tracking, invoice generation and expense management. Built for freelancers and contractors who value their time.

preview.title: Beautiful insights at a glance
preview.subtitle: Your financial overview, simplified and elegant.

features.title: Everything you need
features.subtitle: Focus on creating. Let OpenTYME handle the admin.

time.title: Time & effort tracking
time.body: Track your work effortlessly. Start, stop and organize sessions with precision to make sure you bill every minute.

invoices.title: Invoicing & billing
invoices.body: Generate professional invoices from tracked time. Automate your billing and get paid faster.

finances.title: Tax-ready finances
finances.body: Get instant insights into your income, expenses and tax liabilities with clear, simple reports.

clients.title: Client & project hub
clients.body: Keep all client and project information organized. Track rates, contacts and communication in one place.

expenses.title: Expense management
expenses.body: Organize your business expenses with receipt uploads and tax categories. Make tax time a breeze.

security.title: Secure & private
security.body: Enterprise-grade security with encrypted data. Your financial information is protected by industry-leading standards.
